standard_prerequisites.name: The duality functors between left and right differential graded modules
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the duality N maps to N-dual with all its properties, through which the embedding into a product of duals is built.

standard_prerequisites.name: Free surjections onto duals and Hom into shifted duals
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, Lemma lemma-good-quotient (its proof) and Lemma lemma-hom-into-shift-dual-free
standard_prerequisites.use: The parallel free-module construction produces the surjection onto M-dual, and the Hom-into-shift-dual lemma turns a separating functional on the cokernel into a map to a shift of A-dual, giving property (2).

core_obligations: The embedding (proof lines 2668-2683): for each k let Q_k be the free left A-module on generators x, y in degrees k, k+1 with d(x) = y, d(y) = 0; the parallel construction from the proof of lemma-good-quotient gives a surjection of a direct sum of such Q_k onto M-dual, and dualizing twice embeds M into the product of the I_k = Q_{-k}-dual, which are the dual right differential graded modules.

The admissible filtration of each summand (proof lines 2684-2688): the short exact sequence 0 to A[-k-1] to Q_k to A[-k] to 0 dualizes to a short exact sequence 0 to A-dual[k] to I_k to A-dual[k+1] to 0, so I is built from products of shifts of A-dual as required by property (3).

Preserving the cokernel (proof lines 2690-2705): given a nonzero class in Coker(d_M) of degree k, pick a functional on M^k vanishing on the image of d but not on the class; by lemma-hom-into-shift-dual-free it corresponds to a homomorphism M to A-dual[k] of differential graded A-modules detecting the class, so adjoining products of shifts of A-dual achieves property (2) while keeping (1) and (3).
proof_roadmap: Construct the free surjection onto M-dual and dualize twice to embed M into a product of the I_k.
Dualize the standard short exact sequence of each Q_k to see each I_k is an extension of shifts of A-dual.
Separate nonzero cokernel classes by functionals and adjoin the corresponding shifted-dual summands to get property (2).
difficulty_reason: The lemma embeds any differential graded module into a product of shifts of A-dual injectively and injectively on the cokernels of the differentials (statement lines 2654-2665). The proof (lines 2667-2705) is a genuine dual-pairing construction: the free-module surjection dualized twice, the admissible two-term structure of each summand dualized to an extension of shifted duals, and a functional-separation argument through the Hom-into-shift-dual lemma for the cokernel condition. H2: the duality bookkeeping and the separation step carry the argument; one ingredient (the free surjection) is the parallel construction from the proof of the sibling lemma lemma-good-quotient, cited in place, and the dependency is recorded on the card.
